ownership: Writer owns scalar next-decision time; it grants no permission. Every nonfresh frame decision rereads advice through the original pinned reader and validates the current source identity. Fresh frames reset the default 200 ms deadline; waits recheck within 200 ms. Existing frame exchange retains generation-tagged admission and lease handoff; rejected idle claims release once, admitted claims remain leased through pacing/write. No new allocations or escaping borrows. Fixture counters track the currently open advice descriptor; path borrowing ends before cleanup, original advice pin closes, frame buffers retire/free before synchronization destruction, private pipe descriptors close before reuse.
boundary_tests: 500 and 1000 ms exact idle sends; expired advice; removed advice; resumed advice; 200 ms rechecks; existing original writer cancellation, mode retirement, reader identity, malformed advice and retained-slot regressions.
